name: Museum Doc
tagline: xiaoma's museum documentary: near-black, parchment type, antique gold and a red stamp, grain and vignette, words fade in one by one.

motion.direction: xiaoma museum documentary. Near-black (never pure black), parchment `iv`, antique gold `ter` ≤ 10 % of the frame, red `goldd` only for the citation `stamp`; Playfair serif titles in sentence case, italic serif for quotes, tracked caps meta in mono. Four corners: year / chapter big number top-left (`chapterCard`), citation + red stamp top-right, subtitle bottom, faint signature bottom-right; the centre is always the moving evidence (`imageCard`, `counter`). Subtitles are the narration: one sentence per screen, words fade in one by one (stagger 0.045), hold 0.5 s after read, then fade. 1–3 % slow push on the whole film, mask-rise reveals 0.45 s outExpo; something new every 2–4 s; grain .08, vignette .6. First 2 s: an object moving, never a title fading on a gradient.
